title: Symthaea Scientific Discovery Prediction Compiler
non_equivalences: prediction declaration is not an observation
outcome predicate is not an observed outcome
prospective commitment is not experimental validation
falsifier linkage must be explicit; it is never inferred
model agreement is not independent corroboration
compiler output cannot satisfy an official challenge criterion
compilation_invariants: prediction identity is deterministically bound to claim, prediction, falsifier, predicates, mechanism and provenance
knowledge and exposure cutoffs are paired and exposure cannot precede knowledge
no observation, replication, or official-criterion evidence type is constructible by this module
